## Summary

This is a Spring PetClinic REST app that uses **OfficeFloor** for request orchestration (YAML-defined function chains), **MapStruct** for DTO mapping, and **OpenAPI-generated DTOs**. Telephone is stored/returned in **E.164 format**. Notably, there is a currently-failing test expecting a new `telephoneDisplay` field that does **not yet exist** anywhere in the production code (openapi.yml, Owner entity, or mapper) — this appears to be the feature to implement.

---

### 1. Owner entity class (telephone field)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`

```java
@Column(name = "telephone")
@NotEmpty
@Pattern(regexp = "^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$", message = "Phone number must be in E.164 form")
private String telephone;
```
The entity has many `@Transient` derived getters that MapStruct maps into the DTO automatically: `getContactPreference()` (line 238), `getAgeBand()` (248), `getIdentityKey()` (259), `getLocality()` (220), `getCheckDigit()` (229), `getPossibleDuplicate()` (209). There is **no** `getTelephoneDisplay()` here.

`getInitials()` lives on the superclass `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java` (line 63), which also holds `firstName`/`lastName`.

### 2. Owner DTO classes
The DTOs are **OpenAPI-generated** (not checked-in source) into `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java` per pom config; they were not present since the project isn't built. Their contract is defined in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`:
- **`OwnerFields`** schema (request fields), starts ~line 2000. `telephone` at **lines 2026-2036**: `type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 20, pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'`, described as "stored and returned in E.164 form, assuming country code +61 when none is supplied." Required fields include `telephone` (line 2081).
- **`Owner`** schema (line 2082) = `allOf` OwnerFields + read-only derived fields: `id, displayName, initials, locality, customerCode, membershipNumber, checkDigit, householdId, namesakeCount, membershipLevel, bulkSignupWarning, contactPreference, ageBand, identityKey, possibleDuplicate, possibleDuplicateOf, pets`. There is **no `telephoneDisplay`** property in the schema.
- Generated Java types referenced in code: `OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerPageDto` (package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`).

### 3. Owner mapper (MapStruct)

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or international form
            (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); stored and returned in E.164 form,
            assuming country code +61 when none is supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied it must be valid for
            the city's region using the fixed city-to-region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the
            owner's age band (see 'ageBand') as of the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only opt-in acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. When true, the create endpoint skips the duplicate-household rejection that
            fires when another owner already has the same last name and postcode, and the owner is
            created as a declared household member rather than being flagged a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION portion of its customerCode, i.e. the region derived from
                the postcode (falling back to the city), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the region code
                derived from the postcode (falling back to the city, else 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last
                name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode,
                guarding against transcription errors of the code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Deterministic identifier of the owner's household: the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode, so owners with the same last
                name and postcode share it automatically. Absent for an owner without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name
                (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on creation. Starting from 1, the
                level gains a point when the owner has an email address and another when it had no
                namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for
                tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on the current date,
                signalling an unusually high sign-up volume; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'PHONE'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from the birth date against the registration date:
                'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no birth date
                was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through, formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners collide
                only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, an existing owner shared this owner's household (same last
                name and postcode) but was reachable on a different telephone (a soft match that is
                still created). A declared household member (opted in via 'sharesHousehold') is never
                flagged. False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one was flagged a possible duplicate of at creation
                (see 'possibleDuplicate'). Absent when not flagged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
